data.lore: A tide-cult of the flooded coast who sing to the water and insist, unsettlingly, that it answers.
data.name: The Drowned Choir

data.lore: A mountain warhost of feuding fire-cults, united only by their hatred of the fog. They burn the mist back one ridge at a time.
data.name: Emberclan

data.lore: The mist keeps its dead, and sometimes gives them back. They walk out with their memories half-intact and their oaths wholly so.
data.name: Hollowborn

data.lore: Dwarven vault-holds beneath the peaks, sealed since the mist rose. Some doors have started opening from the inside.
data.name: Runebound Halls

data.lore: Serpentfolk of the Sunken Marches, who thrive inside the fog that drowns everyone else. Their warqueen has decided the vale is theirs.
data.name: Sskarn Broods

data.lore: Fey of the deepwood, who bargain in favours and briars and have never once explained their terms plainly.
data.name: Thornweald Court

data.lore: Knight-remnants of the old federation, still keeping oaths sworn to kingdoms the mist swallowed. Discipline, steel, and a refusal to yield ground twice.
data.name: Vale Sentinels

data.lore: An itinerant conclave of mist-scholars, hedge-wizards and pilgrims who study the Worldmist rather than flee it.
data.name: The Wayfarers
